misc: Bags Miura irons and is rumoured to sleep with them.
biography: Miso, representing Hirsala Golf, has established himself as a prominent figure in the Hector Trophée, having participated in ten previous editions of this esteemed pair competition. His consistent engagement over the years underscores a deep-seated commitment to the sport and the distinctive challenges presented by this event's unique format.

His competitive journey is notably marked by a triumphant victory in the coveted Hector Trophée, achieved alongside a partner, a clear testament to his exceptional collaborative acumen and ability to perform under pressure in the team environment. While this collective success stands as a significant highlight, the individual Victor Trophy has, to date, remained a yet-to-be-captured aspiration, underscoring the demanding dual nature of the tournament.

Miso's profound dedication to his craft is perhaps most vividly illustrated by his choice of equipment and the lore that surrounds it. He famously wields Miura irons, instruments celebrated for their unparalleled precision and exquisite feel, a selection that speaks volumes about his discerning and meticulous approach to the game. It is even playfully rumored among his peers that his bond with these finely forged clubs is so profound, he occasionally sleeps with them, a testament to his intense passion and unwavering focus on his game.

While Miso maintains an active presence within competitive golf, he will regrettably not be among the competitors for the forthcoming Hector Trophée 2026. Nevertheless, his history of a team victory, coupled with his steadfast commitment and unique on-course character, ensures that his potential return to future editions of this prestigious championship will be keenly anticipated by enthusiasts of the event.
